items.title: Local LLM Cold-Start Inference Latency on Consumer Hardware
items.description: When invoking local Ollama models (e.g. qwen3-coder:latest or qwen3:8b) for autonomous code generation, cold model loading into VRAM on Windows can take 15 to 75 seconds depending on hardware and model quantization.
items.mitigation: Implemented deterministic fallback in DevelopmentPlanner so if Ollama is slow or unavailable, task planning falls back to deterministic regex rule templates.

items.title: Android Companion App Requires Shared Local Area Network (LAN)
items.description: Android phone companion server binds to local network (port 8788). It does not perform STUN/TURN cellular NAT traversal; remote companion operation requires private LAN or VPN (e.g., Tailscale).
items.mitigation: Documentation specifies Private Network firewall configuration and home LAN recommendation.

items.title: Windows Desktop Observation Suspended While Workstation is Locked
items.description: Desktop screen capture and Win32 UI Automation (UIA) APIs cannot capture the interactive desktop surface when Windows session is locked (Win+L) or screen saver is active.
items.mitigation: Native supervisor reports reachable: false and gracefully buffers events until workstation unlock.

items.title: Unattended Tasks Throttle Under Host CPU Load Exceeding 90%
items.description: ResourceMonitor monitors CPU and RAM. When system-wide CPU load ratio exceeds 90% or free RAM drops below 250 MB, background dev subtasks back off up to 3 seconds to avoid starving host operations.
items.mitigation: Exponential moving average smoothing prevents false positive spikes from 100ms ticks, and subtask retry backoff avoids burning retries.

items.title: Single-Node Local Daemon Architecture
items.description: JARVIS 4.0 architecture is designed as a sovereign, single-node local executive daemon. Distributed multi-machine task federation across separate physical hosts is outside the v4.0 design scope.
items.mitigation: Architecturally isolated data directories and process lock management permit multiple local daemon instances on different ports.
